_help: The one list that drives every language on the site and in the CVs. To add a language: put its code in "languages" (it must have an entry in "catalog"), then run `npm run i18n:add`. To remove one, delete its code here. "primary" are the languages I work in; all others show a note that they were translated automatically. "legal" are the languages the Legal Notice and Privacy Policy exist in; the others link to English.
_catalogHelp: Known languages. name: the language in its own name (shown in the menus). intl: the locale used for dates and numbers. dir: rtl for right-to-left scripts. script: picks the fonts (latin = Manrope; arabic = Cairo on the site and in the CV; others need a font, see README). letters: false for scripts whose letters join or combine, so headlines are never split into single letters. cvDates: numeric writes CV dates as MM/YYYY (the German convention); otherwise short month names. lowerRoles: job titles are written in Title Case in the data and lowered in the middle of a sentence (English).
_scriptsHelp: Fonts per script. site: the font the website adds after Manrope (null = Manrope only). cv: the @fontsource package the CV embeds after Manrope. A script without a site font falls back to the visitor's system fonts until one is added in src/i18n/fonts.ts; npm run i18n:check warns about that.
